SELECT
    TRIM(p."matnr") AS material_number,
    MAX(COALESCE(TRIM(m."maktx"), TRIM(p."arktx"), p."matnr"::text)) AS product_name,
    v."waerk" AS currency,
    SUM(COALESCE(p."netwr"::numeric, 0)) AS total_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(p."fkimg"::numeric, 0)) AS total_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v."vbeln") AS invoice_count
FROM vbrp p
JOIN "VBRK" v ON v."mandt" = p."mandt" AND v."vbeln" = p."vbeln"
LEFT JOIN "MAKT" m ON m."mandt" = p."mandt" AND TRIM(m."matnr") = TRIM(p."matnr") AND m."spras" = 'E'
WHERE p."matnr" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p."matnr") != ''
GROUP BY TRIM(p."matnr"), v."waerk"
HAVING SUM(COALESCE(p."netwr"::numeric, 0)) > 0
ORDER BY total_sales DESC

SELECT
    TRIM(p."matnr") AS material_number,
    MAX(COALESCE(TRIM(m."maktx"), TRIM(p."arktx"), p."matnr"::text)) AS product_name,
    v."waerk" AS currency,
    SUM(COALESCE(p."netwr"::numeric, 0)) AS total_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(p."fkimg"::numeric, 0)) AS total_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v."vbeln") AS invoice_count
FROM vbrp p
JOIN "VBRK" v ON v."mandt" = p."mandt" AND v."vbeln" = p."vbeln"
LEFT JOIN "MAKT" m ON m."mandt" = p."mandt" AND TRIM(m."matnr") = TRIM(p."matnr") AND m."spras" = 'E'
WHERE p."matnr" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p."matnr") != ''
GROUP BY TRIM(p."matnr"), v."waerk"
HAVING SUM(COALESCE(p."netwr"::numeric, 0)) > 0
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT     v."netwr" AS "amount",     v1."vbeln" AS "billing_doc",     v1."fkdat" AS "billing_date",     v1."fkdat" AS "year_from_fkdat",     v1."waerk" AS "currency",     k."name1" AS "customer_name"
FROM "vbrp" AS v

LEFT JOIN "VBRK" AS v1
    ON v."vbeln" = v1."vbeln"

LEFT JOIN "KNA1" AS k
    ON v1."kunag" = k."kunnr" WHERE (SUBSTRING(TRIM(v1."fkdat"),1,4) = '2005')

ORDER BY v."netwr" DESC

LIMIT 100;

SELECT r."vbeln", r."fkdat", r."land1", SUM(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(v."netwr" AS text)), '') AS numeric)) AS total_netwr, r."waerk" AS currency
FROM "VBRK" r
JOIN vbrp v ON LPAD(TRIM(v."vbeln"),10,'0') = LPAD(TRIM(r."vbeln"),10,'0')
WHERE SUBSTRING(TRIM(r."fkdat"), 1, 4) = '2001'
GROUP BY r."vbeln", r."fkdat", r."land1", r."waerk"
ORDER BY r."land1"

       k.name1 AS customer_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT vk.vbeln) AS invoice_count,
       SUM(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(vk.netwr), '') AS NUMERIC)) AS total_sales,
       vk.waerk AS currency
FROM "VBRK" vk
LEFT JOIN "KNA1" k ON vk.kunag = k.kunnr
GROUP BY vk.kunag, k.name1, vk.waerk
ORDER BY invoice_count DESC

SELECT vk.kunag AS customer_number,
       k.name1 AS customer_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT vk.vbeln) AS invoice_count,
       SUM(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(vk.netwr), '') AS NUMERIC)) AS total_sales,
       vk.waerk AS currency
FROM "VBRK" vk
LEFT JOIN "KNA1" k ON vk.kunag = k.kunnr
GROUP BY vk.kunag, k.name1, vk.waerk
ORDER BY invoice_count DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT
    vbrk."waerk" AS currency,
    SUM(NULLIF(TRIM(vbrp."netwr"::text), '')::numeric) AS total_sales
FROM "vbrp" AS vbrp
JOIN "VBRK" AS vbrk ON LPAD(TRIM(vbrp."vbeln"), 10, '0') = LPAD(TRIM(vbrk."vbeln"), 10, '0')
WHERE SUBSTRING(TRIM(vbrk."fkdat"), 1, 4) = '{year}'
GROUP BY vbrk."waerk"
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
    TRIM(p."matnr") AS material_number,
    MAX(COALESCE(TRIM(m."maktx"), TRIM(p."arktx"), p."matnr"::text)) AS product_name,
    v."waerk" AS currency,
    SUM(COALESCE(p."netwr"::numeric, 0)) AS total_sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(p."fkimg"::numeric, 0)) AS total_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v."vbeln") AS invoice_count
FROM vbrp p
JOIN "VBRK" v ON v."mandt" = p."mandt" AND v."vbeln" = p."vbeln"
LEFT JOIN "MAKT" m ON m."mandt" = p."mandt" AND TRIM(m."matnr") = TRIM(p."matnr") AND m."spras" = 'E'
WHERE p."matnr" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p."matnr") != ''
GROUP BY TRIM(p."matnr"), v."waerk"
HAVING SUM(COALESCE(p."netwr"::numeric, 0)) > 0
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT t.brtxt AS industry, SUM(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(v."netwr" AS TEXT)), '') AS NUMERIC)) AS value FROM vbrp v JOIN "VBRK" r ON v.vbeln = r.vbeln JOIN "KNA1" k ON r.kunag = k.kunnr LEFT JOIN "T016T" t ON k.brsch = t.brsch GROUP BY t.brtxt ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT
    fg."prctr" AS profit_center,
    COALESCE(c."name1", fg."prctr") AS profit_center_name,
    SUM(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(fg."hsl" AS TEXT)), '') AS NUMERIC)) AS total_cost
FROM "FAGLFLEXA" AS fg
LEFT JOIN "CEPC" AS c ON fg."prctr" = c."prctr"
WHERE fg."prctr" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(fg."prctr") != ''
GROUP BY fg."prctr", c."name1"
ORDER BY total_cost DESC
LIMIT 20;

    COALESCE(SUM(NULLIF(TRIM(p."netwr"::text),'')::NUMERIC), 0) AS total_netwr,     -- Sum of NETWR per currency, handling zero rows
